mapper.insert: insert into attachments (id, message_id, user_id, storage_path, file_type) values (#{id}, #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{storagePath}, #{fileType})
mapper.update: update attachments set message_id = #{messageId} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and message_id is null
update attachments set message_id = null where message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.delete: delete from attachments where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and message_id is null
mapper.select: select a.id, a.message_id, a.user_id, a.storage_path, a.file_type, a.created_at from attachments a join messages m on a.message_id = m.id where m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by a.created_at, a.id
